en: Conditioned by a state with a non-past object that is not wholesome, a wholesome state with a past object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-one [conditions] in the case of roots ... pe ... twenty-one in the case of non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state with a non-past object that is not unwholesome, an unwholesome state with a past object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Twenty-one [conditions] in the case of roots ... pe ... twenty-one in the case of non-disappearance.
